descriptions.w3d_d24b_girder_points_80095b58: Girder point transform: builds the matrix from the identity 0x8045e748 and the axis (+332, +312, 0) (0x801a3eb0), sets its translation from the position +208, scales it (0x801f781c, 2.0 when +688 is 1, else 1.0), transforms the eight corners and four markers at +348 into the table 144 bytes further on, and copies the position to +172.
